description: Thinking-off resolution, replayed by _shared/lua/llm/thinking_off.lua (macOS and Linux suites) and its AutoHotkey port _shared/modules/llm/thinking_off.ahk (Windows suite) over the shipped _shared/modules/llm/thinking_off.json families and api_providers.json thinking_dialect, so the drivers cannot drift.
rule: normalize_vectors: lowercase, last path segment, an Ollama :tag dropped. glob_vectors: a glob matches the whole id, ignoring case, * the only wildcard. merge_vectors: fields deep-merged into body give expected (the body wins at every level); added lists the paths added. resolve_vectors: the model's family (first match on the normalized id) through the provider's dialect (first control kind it carries, $level filled) merged into body gives expected; family is its 1-based index and kind the control applied, both absent when none. refusal_vectors: after resolution, an HTTP 400 whose message names an added key (snake or camel; a generic leaf as parent.leaf) refuses its top-level field, stripped from the body (expected); field absent when nothing is refused. refused_vectors: a refused top-level field is never added. family_parse_vectors and dialect_parse_vectors: accepted whole (valid true) or refused whole. sampling_vectors: whether the model's family accepts only the default sampling (no temperature sent). refusal_store_vectors: a persisted store "<provider>|<model>" -> field -> epoch second keeps each valid field refused less than refusal_expiry_days (thinking_off.json) before now and not after it; a key left with none, or without |, is dropped and counted. ollama_think_vectors: the think value of an Ollama chat body: the model family's first control Ollama carries, false for a toggle or an off intent, the level of an effort control whose level is in ollama_think_levels (thinking_off.json), false with no family or no such control. A families table also needs capability_listing (model_capabilities.lua parse_config): ttl_hours a positive integer, providers a non-empty object of provider id -> listing dialect, page_query an object of listing dialect -> one name=number query.
